stages.reference: Study the delicate optical texture beneath the surface of old green stained glass. Preserve the earthy bottle-green and soft olive mineral tone of the main layer; any air inclusions, wavy cooling bands and faded surface abrasion must remain scarce and subdued. This is not another picture of green glass but the detail that subtly enriches one specific parent material. Let transmitted light reveal gentle variations while keeping the sheet legible and the source-defined empty detail regions transparent. Avoid moss, foliage, etched decorations, glossy emerald facets, high-contrast scratches, wide fractures, neon green lighting or a dark opaque square. The strongest impression should remain the companion glass's coherent aged green material.
